entries.clue: Armoured horseman of gentle birth; first to be portrayed, veteran of fifteen battles
Pocket volume telling the traveller what to see and where to eat
Looping line linking every point at one height
Three initials whose satellite signals let your phone work out where it stands
Quick look through the curtains, or the note Thomas the Tank Engine whistles, twice
Theban who prays to Venus and gets the lady after all
Duke who builds a round theatre for a fight over one woman
'Fell off the back of a ___': artic whose recorded voice warns the street it is reversing
Kitchen wireless whose dial hisses past foreign voices until the cricket swims into tune
The threadbare scholar's horse was as lean as this toothed garden tool
Rutted farm lane, or the rails a train never leaves
Weathered granite outcrop crowning a Dartmoor hill
Four coloured buttons, every one with a note of its own: the 1978 electronic memory game
Tumbling laundry machine that sings out when your towels are toasty.
